scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @sapiensmetric/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sapiensmetric/assessment build && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @sapiensmetric/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sapiensmetric/contracts test && pnpm --filter @sapiensmetric/api test
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @sapiensmetric/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sapiensmetric/assessment build && pnpm --filter @sapiensmetric/api build && pnpm --filter @sapiensmetric/web build
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && bash scripts/verify.sh
